Class Sphere

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.geometry.Sphere
public class Sphere extends Object
A sphere in three-dimensional Cartesian space.

Distances are measured relative to the sphere surface: signed distances are negative inside the sphere, zero on the surface, and positive outside the sphere.

Author:
heddle

  • Constructor Details

    • Sphere

      public Sphere(Point center, double radius)
      Creates a sphere with the given center and radius.
      Parameters:
      center - the center of the sphere
      radius - the radius of the sphere; must be non-negative
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if center is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if radius is negative or non-finite, or a center coordinate is non-finite

    • Sphere

      public Sphere(double[] center, double radius)
      Creates a sphere from an xyz center array and a radius.
      Parameters:
      center - an array containing the center coordinates x, y, and z
      radius - the radius of the sphere; must be non-negative
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if center is null
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if center.length < 3
      IllegalArgumentException - if radius is negative or non-finite, or a center coordinate is non-finite

    • Sphere

      public Sphere(double radius)
      Creates a sphere centered at the origin.
      Parameters:
      radius - the radius of the sphere; must be non-negative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if radius is negative or non-finite

    • segmentIntersects

      public boolean segmentIntersects(double x1, double y1, double z1, double x2, double y2, double z2)
      Tests whether a finite line segment intersects the sphere.

      Tangency counts as intersection.

      Parameters:
      x1 - the x coordinate of one segment endpoint
      y1 - the y coordinate of one segment endpoint
      z1 - the z coordinate of one segment endpoint
      x2 - the x coordinate of the other segment endpoint
      y2 - the y coordinate of the other segment endpoint
      z2 - the z coordinate of the other segment endpoint
      Returns:
      true if the segment intersects or is tangent to the sphere
